staticPages.aboutSeoTitle: About Rate.vn - Open-Core Product Spec & Price Intelligence | Rate.vn
staticPages.aboutSeoDesc: Learn how Rate.vn standardizes 10 technical specification groups, detects inflated fake discounts, and audits marketplace reviews with AI.
staticPages.aboutHeroDesc: Rate.vn was built to solve the 3 biggest pain points of buying tech on e-commerce marketplaces: vague or inconsistent specs across variants, inflated strikethrough prices before sale days to fake deep discounts, and thousands of coin-farming or seeding comments distorting star ratings.
staticPages.aboutPillarsTitle: Three Core Technical Pillars of Rate.vn
staticPages.aboutPillarsDescPrefix: All normalization and scoring algorithms are openly published in the
staticPages.aboutPillar1Desc: ProductNormalizer and EntityMatcher automatically cluster dozens of marketplace listings selling the same device into a single canonical entity (rate.master_products) via deterministic model_key, pg_trgm similarity, and AI extraction across 10 GSMArena & PhoneArena spec groups.
staticPages.aboutPillar2Desc: Instead of trusting seller-entered "strikethrough prices", Rate.vn stores real time-series observations in rate.price_history (deduplicated by observation_id) and benchmarks current prices against 30-90 day historical medians to expose pre-sale price inflation.
staticPages.aboutPillar3Title: 3. Dual Risk Score & JReviews Logarithmic Weights
staticPages.aboutPillar3Desc: Every review is classified by AiReviewAnalyzer into 5 categories (authentic, low_value_coin_spam, seeding_fake, repetitive_template, sabotage_or_bombing). Only authentic reviews enter the JReviews logarithmic weight formula 1 + ln(1 + helpful_votes).
staticPages.aboutOpenCoreDesc: Merchant trust scores (trust_score) and weighted product ratings (user_rating_weighted) are computed automatically by SECURITY DEFINER functions and triggers inside PostgreSQL 17. No individual or sponsor can manually alter or inflate scores.
staticPages.aboutBullet1Desc: All table definitions, JReviews scoring formulas, and fake-discount detection functions are open in supabase/migrations.
staticPages.aboutBullet2Desc: Strictly isolates sensitive personal data (PII) from public lookup views via Row-Level Security (RLS).
staticPages.aboutBullet3Desc: Provides an open JSON standard for browsers, the MV3 extension, and market researchers.
staticPages.aboutLinkFaq: ❓ Frequently Asked Questions on Scoring Methodology
staticPages.privacySeoDesc: Rate.vn privacy policy and data governance: database-level PII protection, SHA-256 anonymous voter hashing, and local browser watchlist storage.
staticPages.privacyHeroDesc: Rate.vn is engineered with Privacy-by-Design: shoppers can look up specs, inspect marketplace links, compare devices, and track price drops without providing any personal identity.
staticPages.privacyS1Desc: When you visit rate.vn to browse products, paste links into the inspector, or query the Open-Core REST API v1, no account is required and no third-party ad-tracking cookies are injected.
staticPages.privacyS2Title: 2. Local Browser Storage for Comparison Tray & Watchlist
staticPages.privacyS2Desc: Products pinned to your comparison tray (/compare) or price alert watchlist (/watchlist) are stored locally in your browser via localStorage. Your browser only sends read-only queries for public price updates.
staticPages.privacyS3Title: 3. Anonymous Review Voting via One-Way SHA-256 Hashing
staticPages.privacyS3Desc: When you click "Helpful" or "Report Seeding" on a product review, your IP address and User-Agent are never stored in plain text. The BFF layer transforms them into a salted one-way SHA-256 digest (voter_hash) solely to prevent duplicate vote spamming in rate.review_votes.
staticPages.privacyS4Desc: Inside PostgreSQL 17 on Supabase Cloud, direct read access to personal contact columns on rate.merchants (phone numbers, internal emails, tax IDs) is revoked. All Web and REST API queries read exclusively from the public rate.merchants_public view with security_invoker = true.
staticPages.privacySide1Desc: All Row-Level Security (RLS) policies, rate.merchants_public view definitions, and voter_hash logic are openly auditable in our public repository.
staticPages.privacySide2Desc: If you are an Official Mall merchant owner and need to update normalized store metadata or request a risk score re-audit, please reach out via our Contact page.
staticPages.faqSeoTitle: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) - Methodology & Trust | Rate.vn
staticPages.faqSeoDesc: Detailed answers on how Rate.vn standardizes 10 specification groups, calculates JReviews weighted ratings, detects fake discounts, and scores merchant risk.
staticPages.faqHeroSubtitle: Detailed explanations of our 10-group technical specification standard, 90-day anti-fake-discount algorithm, and AI Seeding filter on Rate.vn.
staticPages.faqQ1: 1. How does Rate.vn’s 10-Field-Groups standard differ from marketplace product specs?
staticPages.faqA1: On e-commerce marketplaces, sellers enter free-form specs or omit critical details like storage standard (UFS 4.0 vs NVMe), peak brightness (nits), or actual charging wattage. Rate.vn normalizes every master product into 10 fixed Zod-validated groups (Launch, Body, Display, Platform, Memory, Multi-Camera split per PhoneArena standard, Audio, Connectivity, Battery, Misc) for exact filtering and side-by-side comparison.
staticPages.faqQ2: 2. How does Rate.vn detect "Inflated Original Price Fake Discounts"?
staticPages.faqA2: Rate.vn never trusts seller-declared strikethrough original prices when evaluating deals. Instead, our engine records actual selling price time series in rate.price_history and computes 30-90 day medians via rate.detect_fake_discount(). If a seller inflates the original price far above historical medians to advertise 40-50% off while the actual selling price is not below the 90-day median, we flag a Fake Discount warning.
staticPages.faqQ3: 3. How does the JReviews weighted rating formula work?
staticPages.faqA3: Unlike naive averages easily manipulated by 5-star coin-farming spam, Rate.vn applies a combined weight formula: Review Weight = (1 - fake_probability) * (1 + ln(1 + helpful_votes)). Reviews classified by AI as coin spam (low_value_coin_spam) or paid seeding (seeding_fake) have include_in_rating = false and are completely excluded from the average.
staticPages.faqQ4: 4. What is included in a merchant’s Dual Risk Score?
staticPages.faqA4: Every merchant in rate.merchants is evaluated across 2 independent axes: (1) DOSafe Threat Intel Risk (0-100): domain history, online scam alerts, and brand impersonation signals; (2) AI Review Seeding Risk (0-100): percentage of audited reviews flagged as seeding/spam. Overall Trust Score = 100 - max(dosafe_risk_score, review_risk_score).
staticPages.faqQ5: 5. Can I test the URL Inspector on any marketplace product link?
staticPages.faqA5: Yes. Using the Homepage search bar ("Paste Shopee / Lazada link to inspect" mode) or GET /api/v1/rate/inspect?url=..., you can paste any Shopee, Lazada, Tiki, or retail product/shop URL to immediately view historical price lows, fake discount warnings, and authentic review ratios.
staticPages.faqQ6: 6. Where do the Price Watchlist (/watchlist) and Comparison Matrix (/compare) store my data?
staticPages.faqA6: To maximize privacy without requiring login accounts, your watched products and comparison tray are stored directly in your browser (localStorage) and automatically synced against live server prices whenever you open the page.
staticPages.faqQ7: 7. Can developers access Rate.vn data via API?
staticPages.faqA7: Yes. Rate.vn provides an open Open-Core REST API v1 at /api/v1/rate/* (with CORS and edge caching). You can read the full documentation and run live queries in the Developer Portal (/developers).
